claims.statement: Pinned date guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; custom date values can be typed or selected from calendar. UI entry does not certify actual permissions, semantic validity or effective native field state.

Date filter uses YYYY-MM-DD with comparison/range operators and @today. Source does not define timezone, range inclusivity, invalid dates or evaluation freshness; no deadline compliance inferred from a matching view.
Roadmap can display date-field items on timeline; display does not enforce schedules, dependencies or completion. Linked layout/filter guides remain separate evidence.

Pinned source says date fields lack defaults; this contrasts text/number defaults and is historical platform reference, not proof current endpoint capability. Date field creation selects Date and saves; no field created.

Pinned text/number guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and describes freeform notes. It provides no maximum length, numeric precision, bounds, validation or sanitization guarantee; source does not establish numeric limits.

Text filter supports field-qualified exact text; unqualified text matches text fields and item titles. Number fields support comparison/range filters. Matching display is not verification of underlying project/repository access or operational truth.
Text and number fields are created by new-field menu, named and saved with respective type. File/procedure existence is not an effective field or native write receipt.

Text/number default values prepopulate newly added items; removal of default leaves existing items unchanged. Source does not demonstrate overwrite/backfill semantics for previously set values, blank/default distinction or update races.
Default edit uses project Settings and Save; stored default is not attestation or accepted evidence. No fields/defaults changed and no rights clearance, accepted policy or native rollout asserted.
